features.description: AI health assistant for general questions
features.name: Dr. Alex - General Health
features.tooltip: Ask Dr. Alex general health questions about your biomarkers and receive personalized recommendations based on your data.

features.description: AI-powered trend analysis of your markers
features.name: Trend Analysis Chat
features.tooltip: Dr. Alex analyzes your biomarker trends over time and explains what the changes mean. Identifies improvements and seasonal patterns.

features.description: Get AI explanations for lab results
features.name: Lab Explanation Chat
features.tooltip: Upload or discuss your lab results with Dr. Alex. Get plain-language explanations of complex lab panels.

features.description: AI-driven personalized diet recommendations
features.name: Personalized Nutrition Chat
features.tooltip: Get personalized nutrition advice from Dr. Alex based on your biomarker levels. Includes food recommendations and dietary adjustments.

features.description: AI supplement review and recommendations
features.name: Supplement Review Chat
features.tooltip: Ask Dr. Alex about supplement interactions with your biomarkers. Understand which supplements may help your health goals.

features.description: Compare health protocols with AI guidance
features.name: Protocol Comparison Chat
features.tooltip: Discuss health protocols (fasting, cold exposure, exercise) with Dr. Alex and understand how they impact your biomarkers.

features.description: See how supplements affect your markers
features.name: Check Influence Factors
features.tooltip: See how your supplements affect individual biomarkers over time. Visual correlation analysis between intake and marker changes.

features.description: Automated trend observations on your dashboard
features.name: AI Dashboard Insights
features.tooltip: AI-powered dashboard that highlights important changes, flags anomalies, and suggests actions without you having to ask.

features.description: Anonymous benchmarking against similar users
features.name: Benchmark
features.tooltip: Compare your anonymized biomarker levels against population averages for your age and gender.

features.description: Compare results across diet and fasting protocols
features.name: Protocol Comparison
features.tooltip: Compare the effectiveness of different health protocols on your specific biomarkers. Data-driven decisions for your health.

features.description: Track blood markers, vitals, and body measurements
features.name: Biomarkers
features.tooltip: The number of different blood markers you can track (e.g., glucose, cholesterol, HbA1c). Higher tiers unlock more markers for a complete health picture.

features.description: Access your historical health data
features.name: Data History
features.tooltip: How far back you can view your measurement history and trends. Longer history helps identify seasonal patterns and long-term changes.

features.description: Auto-computed health scores like GKI, BMI, HOMA-IR
features.name: Calculated Markers
features.tooltip: Markers automatically computed from your measurements, such as GKI (Glucose-Ketone Index), BMI, WHtR, or HOMA-IR. No manual calculation needed.

features.description: Save reusable measurement routines
features.name: Measurement Templates
features.tooltip: Save custom measurement templates for your regular blood tests. One click to load your usual markers instead of selecting them each time.

features.description: Track supplements, medications, and other factors that affect your markers
features.name: Influence Factors
features.tooltip: Track medications, supplements, and their ingredients to understand how they affect your biomarkers over time.

features.description: Total measurements you can store
features.name: Measurements
features.tooltip: The total number of blood test entries you can record. Each entry can contain multiple marker values from a single blood draw.

features.description: Fat, muscle, water, and bone tracking
features.name: Body Composition
features.tooltip: Track body composition metrics like weight, body fat, muscle mass, and waist circumference alongside your blood markers.

features.description: Set your own reference ranges per marker
features.name: Reference Ranges
features.tooltip: Set your own reference ranges for any biomarker based on your doctor recommendations or personal health goals.

features.description: Preset protocols for keto, fasting, carnivore
features.name: Lifestyle Presets
features.tooltip: Configure default lifestyle settings like diet protocol, fasting regimen, and exercise routine for personalized reference ranges.

features.description: Run Sovereign Health on your Start9 server at home.
features.name: StartOS Package
features.tooltip: One-click installation via the StartOS marketplace. Automatic Tor onion service, local database, full data sovereignty. Your health data never leaves your home network.

features.description: Programmatic access to your health data
features.name: REST API Access
features.tooltip: Access your health data programmatically via a REST API. Build custom integrations or connect automation tools.

features.description: Run your own instance with SaaS sync
features.name: Self-Hosted Hybrid
features.tooltip: Run Sovereign Health on your own server with full control. Optionally connect to the SaaS for cloud features like AI and benchmarks.

features.description: 1:1 setup session with our team
features.name: Personal Onboarding
features.tooltip: A dedicated 1:1 setup session with our team to configure your account, set up devices, and customize reference ranges.

features.description: Fast-track support response
features.name: Priority Support
features.tooltip: Skip the queue with priority support. Faster response times for technical issues and health data questions.

features.description: Community and email support
features.name: Standard Support
features.tooltip: Access to community forums and email support for questions, bug reports, and feature suggestions. Available on every plan.

features.description: Download your data as CSV
features.name: CSV Export
features.tooltip: Export all your health data as CSV spreadsheets. Compatible with Excel, Google Sheets, and any data analysis tool.

features.description: Download your data as JSON
features.name: JSON Export
features.tooltip: Export your health data in structured JSON format for developers, researchers, or integration with other platforms.

features.description: Generate styled PDF health reports
features.name: PDF Health Reports
features.tooltip: Generate professional PDF health reports with charts, reference ranges, and trend analysis. Share with your doctor.

features.description: AI-assisted lab result parsing and import
features.name: Lab Result Import
features.tooltip: Upload photos of lab reports or PDFs and let AI automatically extract your biomarker values. No manual data entry needed.

features.description: AI-assisted influence factor list import
features.name: Influence Factor Import
features.tooltip: Import medications and supplements from photos of packaging. AI extracts product names, dosages, and ingredients automatically.

features.description: Access your health data anonymously via the Tor network.
features.name: Tor Browser Support
features.tooltip: Your health dashboard is accessible as a Tor onion service. All traffic stays within the Tor network -- your IP address is never revealed to our servers.

features.description: TOTP-based two-factor authentication
features.name: Two-Factor Authentication
features.tooltip: Protect your account with time-based one-time passwords (TOTP). Works with Google Authenticator, Authy, or hardware keys.

features.description: Sign in with your Nostr identity. No email or password required.
features.name: Nostr Login (nsec)
features.tooltip: Authenticate using your Nostr secret key (nsec) via NIP-98. Your key remains under your control and is never stored on our servers.
